maria: Quick note — customer hit a runtime crash only when deploying to Cloudflare Workers (Vite + worker adapter). Node SSR is fine. Error: 

devon: paste the error and minimal repro?

maria: Error at runtime: 
```
ReferenceError: exports is not defined
  at f (/assets/index.js:1:234)
  at handleRequest (edge-runtime:56)
```
Repro steps I used:
1) npm init -y && npm i vite@4 @cloudflare/workers-types redwood-inference-js
2) index.mjs:
```js
import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference-js';
export default {
  fetch() {
    createClient({ apiKey: 'x' });
    return new Response('ok');
  }
}
```
3) vite build --ssr && wrangler publish --target=modules

maria: Inspecting dist shows an IIFE that references `exports.` inside an ESM bundle — breaks in worker runtimes that don't provide CommonJS shims.

dryan: (note) this looks like the published .mjs still contains CJS interop helpers. Some bundlers (vite/rollup) won't strip them when node_modules are externalized.

dryan: Temporary workarounds that worked in two repos:
- Vite: add to vite.config.js: `ssr: { noExternal: ['redwood-inference-js'] }, optimizeDeps: { include: ['redwood-inference-js'] }`
- Webpack/Rollup: force-transpile the package (babel/transform) to normalize interop

ryan: Those hacks increase bundle size or are brittle. Long-term fix: SDK should publish a pure ESM entry with no `exports.` helpers and an explicit package.json `exports` map: { "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs" }. Also ensure `types` field points at `dist/index.d.ts` so TS users don't see `any`.

pkg-bot: CI: sample-app-workers build failed (job 542). Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/542/logs

maria: I'll open a tiny repro repo (single-file) and attach the failing bundle snippet to the SDK issue.

dryan: I'll draft an SDK packaging PR to emit a clean ESM bundle (no interop helpers) and update exports/types. Also add a CI lint that scans ESM assets for `exports.` occurrences to catch regressions.

ryan: For docs, add a short entry under SDK DX: "Edge bundlers — temporary workarounds" listing `ssr.noExternal` and the optimizeDeps include, plus a note that this is a packaging bug to be fixed upstream.

maria: Marking thread resolved once PR merges. Will post links here when available. :rocket:
